name: Log K2 Rate Decision
query:
SELECT public.k2_log_operational_event(
  p_event_type := 'rate_gate',
  p_clinic_id := $1::uuid,
  p_patient_id := $2::uuid,
  p_conversation_id := $3::uuid,
  p_status := CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN 'allowed' ELSE 'deferred' END,
  p_decision := CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN 'priority_allow' ELSE CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN 'allow' ELSE 'defer' END END,
  p_metadata := jsonb_build_object('recent_conversation_count', $6::integer, 'recent_clinic_count', $7::integer, 'conversation_limit', $8::integer, 'clinic_limit', $9::integer, 'window_seconds', $10::integer)
);
queryReplacement: ={{ [$("Normalize & Validate").first().json.clinic_id, $("Normalize & Validate").first().json.patient_id, $("Normalize & Validate").first().json.conversation_id, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.allowed === true, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.priority_allow === true, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.recent_conversation_count || 0, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.recent_clinic_count || 0, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.conversation_limit || 8, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.clinic_limit || 300, $("K2 Inbound Burst Rate Gate").first().json.window_seconds || 15] }}
notes: Operational telemetry only. Stores decision/counts and scoped identifiers; no message content and no token quota.
